The mapping this item asks to add is, in fact, already present in the current traceability.md's Task Mapping table (e.g. the existing row 'T-001 | REQ-001 | AC-001 | ...'), so the item both targets a frozen artifact and describes content that predates the gate. Each of the 8 occurrences should instead name a non-frozen addendum record (e.g. an implementation-report cross-reference or a specs/sdd-context/verification/ entry).
